name: Breakthrough Junior Challenge
description: Breakthrough Junior Challenge is a science competition listed under International / Other for ages 13-18. Secondary school students aged 13-18 worldwide. Registration deadline 15 Sept 2026. Fee: Free.

name: John Locke Essay Competition
description: An elite global essay contest organized by the John Locke Institute. Promotes high-quality essay writing across Economics, History, Politics, Philosophy, Theology, Law, and Psychology.

name: IRIS National Science Fair
description: India's premier national science research competition. Winners represent India at the Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF) in the USA.

name: UKMT Senior Mathematical Challenge
description: A 90-minute, multiple-choice challenge that encourages mathematical reasoning, precision of thought, and fluency in using basic mathematical techniques to solve interesting problems.

name: Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament (HMMT)
description: One of the largest and most prestigious high school mathematics competitions in the world, run by students at Harvard and MIT.
